provider.launch: agentdocker run --runtime claude-code --tty --claude-channel; normal agentdocker attach
provider.scope: Private daemon/home/socket/workspace/profile. Owned executable wrapper reads existing login in memory and execs Claude. Authentication is never sent in the persisted launch specification.
provider.consent: Accepted only the owned empty workspace and locally built AgentDocker development channel.

draft.evidence: Observed in the managed PTY before, during and after the model turn.

retained_failures: Initial full gate stopped at host module ordering; corrected before successful gate.
Restricted final UI recheck failed 10 private-socket fixture binds with Operation not permitted; authorized rerun passed all 106.
During cleanup /exit was unavailable with slash commands disabled; two Ctrl-D keys within the confirmation interval exited normally.
limits: This trial covers one provider version, policy and platform.
Private trial explicitly used --strict-mcp-config for isolation; normal managed launch does not add it. Coexistence with every existing MCP/policy configuration is not certified.
No actual-provider reconnect/ambiguous receipt, cancellation/starvation, overnight or reboot acceptance in this trial.
UI checkbox rendering is separate fixture evidence, not an actual model launched by clicking the checkbox.
Codex submitted input and idle wake remain open.
Installed launcher and daemon are unchanged; physical notification clicks, signing and independent hardware acceptance remain open.
